scoring_justification: The dispersion formulas are deterministic given the input constants; the checker recomputes ω and computes RMSE.

outputs.description: Scored artifact: the computed dispersion curves. The checker independently recomputes the expected frequencies at each k point from the known formulas and inputs, then scores the agent's frequencies by the recomputed RMS error, with full credit for excellent agreement.

output_contract.notes: The agent must ensure at least 20 equally spaced k points per curve, spanning from 0 to the appropriate Brillouin‑zone boundary for each direction. Frequencies must be reported in 10¹³ rad/s.
